versions.changelog:
- Initial release of zhuang-infochart-master.
- Enables users to generate high-quality image prompts for knowledge visuals, data charts, flow diagrams, concept explanations, and more.
- Guides users through content type selection, style recommendation, and precise prompt generation, including English/Chinese explanation.
- Manages all content, prompts, styles, and outputs in a structured run folder for each task.
- Includes support for multiple visual styles (2.5D, Web UI, Notion hand-drawn, etc.) and fallback image generation scripts.
- Bundles style catalog, prompt templates, and scripts for simplified workflow and easy customization.
